svg.text: the state that decides the verdict
N terminal EMPTY — auto-indexing sets it
Clear Errors runs LAST, and only after the code and source are already inside note. Clear first and you
throw away the only evidence of what broke the station.
A tester error is not a fail. In the True frame there is no pass/fail arithmetic at all — the verdict is
TesterError and the results array is left as it stands.
Do NOT wire the For Loop N terminal. The auto-indexing input tunnel (drawn with square brackets) sets N to
the array length. Wire N as well and the smaller of the two wins — silently.
legend: grey = TCP refnum, olive/thick = cluster (error, limits, Result, TestData), blue = enum + I32, orange = DBL, pink = string, green = boolean
N terminal empty — do not wire N
